json_schema.description: A local resource whose spawn_intent was already closed spawn_failed has been reclaimed. Exists because this is the one DESTRUCTIVE and otherwise UNATTRIBUTABLE action the reconciler takes: without a log record, a worktree simply disappears with nothing saying who removed it or why. Recorded only AFTER the resource is actually gone — the log is append-only, so a premature record could never be retracted. NOT spillable: a destructive action recorded only on the host that performed it is invisible to everyone investigating why an agent vanished.
